description: Merge an open PR. Enforces the same checks as the HTTP merge flow: not a draft, head SHA resolves, GateTest+AI-review hard gates pass, branch-protection rules satisfied. M3: soft-blocks when the pre-merge risk score is `critical` unless `confirm_high_risk: true` is passed. Returns {merged, sha?, reason?, riskScore?}.

confirm_high_risk.description: When true, bypass the M3 risk-score soft-block on critical-band PRs.

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_merge_pr
